items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per reports, but same knee had PCL sprain/bone bruise last year—scary history.
items.why: Meniscus trim; coach/reports optimistic short absence but prior knee issues raise concern.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Michael Mayer elevated TE1 if out. Hold Bowers.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; team monitoring how he feels this week vs Raiders. Rapoport notes testing for severity.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; left game but finished with production.
items.implication: If out, Tre Harris or others see bump; ETR flags Tre Harris as primary beneficiary.

items.text: Malik Nabers encouraging return: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% share), 6-69. Limited but efficient and healthy post-ACL/meniscus. Giants win context positive.
items.why: First game since Sep 2025; high target share on limited snaps shows trust.
items.implication: Ramp up expected; WR1 upside intact if volume grows.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week per FF Happy Hour.
items.why: Opportunity from teammate absence (Stribling) and role in WAS offense.
items.implication: Priority add for WR depth/flex upside.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) inactive Week 1; expected return Week 2. Kendre Miller primary beneficiary/backup to Etienne. ETR flags Miller as waiver add.
items.why: Knee (MCL); full practice but cautious, planned ease-in.
items.implication: Miller stash/add while Etienne lead; Kamara likely back W2 reducing Miller.
items.opportunity: Miller elevated snaps/carries with Kamara out

items.text: A.J. Brown injury (high ankle sprain context, multi-week) creates beneficiaries Romeo Doubs and DeMario Douglas for waivers/streaming.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed MRI; 4-6 weeks possible.
items.implication: Doubs primary WR upside add in NE.

items.text: Week 2 injury beneficiaries for waivers: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; Dylan Sampson=Raheim Sanders; A.J. Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel.
items.why: Direct fallout from OUT/DTD players creating snap/target openings.
items.implication: Prioritize these adds for immediate and stash value; FAAB guidance included.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9, only 2.5 last night with just 2 targets (7% share). Routes present (29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks) but volume needed for fantasy payoff; Worthy led routes.
items.why: Walker-centric offense and conservative passing limited deep/volume opportunities; possible lingering knee.
items.implication: Needs targets spike to return value; monitor for zone/trailing games.
items.opportunity: 29 routes but 7% target share, low aDOT

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in KC debut, ran 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share), finishing 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected.
items.why: Dominant early-down and receiving usage in new offense with Mahomes; forced 14 missed tackles.
items.implication: Locked RB1 with massive ceiling; handcuff Emmett Johnson must-own.
items.opportunity: 29/32 RB opps, 19 routes, 6 targets, goal-line/red-zone involvement

items.text: Kenneth Walker is a full grown man after MNF explosion; major Monday Night Miracle performer.
Dylan Sampson to IR (knee); Raheim Sanders next man up/beneficiary for CLE backfield.
items.why: Knee injury leading to IR (min 4 games).
items.implication: Sanders pure stash; Judkins still lead but committee risk.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks Week 1 even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early; Browns used Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Limited receiving role despite opportunity with Sampson out.
items.implication: Pass-game involvement lagging; Sanders beneficiary of IR.

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2/WR3/TE2 usage.
items.why: Elite concentration on top four skill players.
items.implication: Start the big four confidently; fade depth pieces.

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage: only 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes/7 targets (all caught). But sole RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked healthy. Strong CLE matchup next.
items.why: Goal-line and route work positive despite modest volume; healthy return.
items.implication: Sustainable RB2/flex with TD upside; Gainwell secondary.
items.opportunity: Goal-line carries, 21 routes > Gainwell, receiving work
